subject: an ivory ribbon bridge connecting two small floating platforms
art_direction: 象牙带桥在两块小型浮台间弯起，云雾与青影形成极简未来园林结构。
visible_description: 象牙带桥在两块小型浮台间弯起，云雾与青影形成极简未来园林结构。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create an ivory ribbon bridge connecting two small floating platforms. Use one broad bridge curve with no cables or mechanical supports. Each platform holds a low patch of grass and a plain stone edge. Keep the entire structure beneath the upper fifth, letting a pale cloud field provide natural empty space. Soft golden light and restrained shadows make the impossible connection believable. Use minimal surreal architectural rendering. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
